versions.subject: Add rule for ECS backdoors
versions.detection:
selection:
    eventSource: ecs.amazonaws.com
    eventName:
        - DescribeTaskDefinition
        - RegisterTaskDefinition
        - RunTask
condition: selection

versions.subject: Update with suggested changes
versions.detection:
selection_source:
    eventSource: ecs.amazonaws.com
    eventName:
        - DescribeTaskDefinition
        - RegisterTaskDefinition
        - RunTask
filter:
  - requestParameters.containerDefinitions.command|contains|all:
      - '169.254'
      - '$AWS_CONTAINER_CREDENTIALS'
condition: selection_source and filter
